# Routing reliability fixtures / 7.11.4

hide-seek-boxes.routefixture and hide-seek-outside-boxes.routefixture are numerical geometry fixtures derived from the user-supplied game9 / Unity2021.2.19f1 scene prefabs and the already included floor meshes. Scope: BoxColliders in a reconstructed standing height band, active hierarchy, objective/player/agent exclusions, actual collision-layer matrix and rigidbody policy; wall/obstacle flags retained. Ground height 0.6144456267 is the supplied Floor BoxCollider top, not a guessed average. Effective controller radius/height/step/slope come from the scene assets; outside uses its actual 5-degree slope setting. Floor/NavMesh world transform comes from the supplied asset. These are static test fixtures, not live game captures, complete runtime collider snapshots or proof of wall culling/dynamic-state behavior. Trigger reach is tested separately in physical_map_tests / physical_edge_tests.

Text format: scene/radius/height/step/slope/floor; spawn/point/vertex/index/part counts; those Vec3 arrays; triangle indices; per part UInt flags, count and Vec3 points. Bounds, source SDK assemblies and textures are not shipped. Tests verify every emitted line against the same supplied floor and physical model, no estimated pairs, preview/search agreement, visible routes and ETA with 22/40/52 selected crystals. Original source assembly hash: ead3f5f861ad7988ad5fdb6f188bb3f77639927dd496b73066860d6c853f0dd8.
